chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Ibrahim ibn Umar al-Yamani from the one who narrated to him from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Surely good deeds take away evil deeds.'
He (peace be upon him) said: 'The prayer of the believer at night erases what he committed of sin during the day.'

key_terms.إِنَّ الْحَسَنَاتِ يُذْهِبْنَ السَّيِّئَ: Surely good deeds take away evil deeds (Quranic phrase)

ai.seo_question: How does night prayer erase sins committed during the day according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this exegetical narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the specific 'good deeds' erasing sins are the night prayers (Qiyam), highlighting the Shia emphasis on nocturnal devotion as a primary mechanism for spiritual purification. This interpretation underscores the transformative power of consistent worship in counteracting daily transgressions, a concept deeply rooted in the tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt. The hadith thus links the general Quranic promise of expiation to the specific practice of night prayer, reinforcing its status as a cornerstone of piety.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Isamil, from Al Fazl Bin Shazan, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Umar Al Yamani, from the one who narrated it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [11:114] surely good deeds take away evil deeds.
Heasws said: ‘A Salāt of the Believer at night erases the sins committed by him during the day’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim ibn ‘Umar al-Yamaniy from those who narrated to him the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, ‘Good deeds eliminate bad deeds 5 [11:116]
has said, ‘It is a reference to the Salah (prayer) of a believing person during the night that eliminate his bad deeds he has done during the day.
